scripts.build: npm run build:panel && npm run build:service
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test panel/index.html service/package.json package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs README.md .prettierrc .vscode/tasks.json
scripts.format: prettier --write src test panel/index.html service/package.json package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs README.md .prettierrc .vscode/tasks.json
scripts.test: npm run build:panel && npm run build:service && npm run build:model:test && npm run build:resources:test && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const file of ['panel/main.js', 'service/main.js']) require('node:fs').rmSync(file, { force: true })"
